XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Power steering

  • Component: Steering box

  • Fault: The steering wheel feels stiff in certain circumstances and the power steering warning light (red steering wheel symbol with “!”) comes on intermittently. An audible warning is also heard. Sometimes the problem disappears and the steering wheel returns to normal operation with no warning lights illuminated.

  • Faults detected by the self-diagnostic system:
    • B200F (Internal control unit fault)
    • B2000 (Internal control unit memory error)
    • U0428 (Invalid data received from the steering angle sensor unit)
  • Cause: Internal fault in the electronic control unit integrated into the steering box.

• Action: Proceed with the replacement of the steering box (which includes the electric motor, control unit and steering box).

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: After replacing the steering box, it is necessary to proceed with adjustment using diagnostic equipment
